release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.0 delivers Owner Controls v2 and the Tachyon Admin Platform: scoped Owner API/RBAC, global license and device management, support/audit/telemetry tooling, signed release policy with feature flags/cohorts/broadcasts, Whop lifecycle linking, member device self-service, authority health/backups, and the command-center UI. Desktop authority now uses a signed entitlement while privileged authorization remains server-side, with no reusable admin bearer token or master secret shipped in TachyonAIO.exe. The release preserves protected local activation and offline lease behavior, migrates existing authority state forward in place, audits privileged mutations, and expands large-fleet, Windows-native, prebuild, and CodeQL release validation.
